description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Amarant
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Counter (0~2), removed after using Apex Counter two times

description.name: Apex Counter Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Counter level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Amarant]

description.name: Apex Counter Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Counter level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Amarant]
